about_the_game:
Journey through the soundscape of the Pyli Kingdom with the Portal Fantasy: Original Soundtrack! The 38 tracks (3 of them bonus) will take you from peaceful towns and mysterious forests to high-stakes battles.

Composed by Ostinarium, the soundtrack blends classic RPG vibes with modern flair, echoing the pixel art charm and emotional depth of the world you explore. It is perfect for bringing your mind back to your favourite quests or providing the perfect ambience for your day.

All tracks all in their full, long form, so you can enjoy 2 hours of music at the highest quality.
Also available in lossless format, so you can experience every note exactly as it was meant to be heard.
